summary: Vistagen Therapeutics filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 22, 2026, disclosing a press release with preliminary positive data from the open-label extension portion of its PALISADE-4 Phase 3 study of fasedienol for acute treatment of social anxiety disorder. No transaction, stake, price, premium, or advisor is involved. The company plans FDA meetings this quarter and believes the program could support an NDA submission. This is a routine clinical-data disclosure, not a special situation; watch regulatory interactions and any subsequent financing or partnership activity.
